title.rendered: How comedian Mortell went viral with his garri content

content.rendered:
Popular skit maker Motell Solomon has opened up about his journey into comedy, revealing that financial challenges played a major role in shaping his career path.

According to him, he initially gained admission to study Medicine and Surgery but later realised it was not the path he wanted to pursue, prompting him to explore other opportunities while still in school.
